title: Four Math Operators Coding
description:
Practice using all four basic math operators in Python!
1. Create a = 20 and b = 4
2. Create add_res = a + b and print it
3. Create sub_res = a - b and print it
4. Create mul_res = a * b and print it
5. Create div_res = a / b and print it
6. Create combo = (a + b) * 2 and print it.
